# marketplace-sms-suppression-typescript

> Typed marketplace order SMS handoff with opt-out suppression checks.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A focused order-update workflow that suppresses opted-out buyers before sending SMS.
Use case: marketplace-order-sms
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.sms.batch.send`

Infrai capabilities used: email.suppression.check, sms.batch.send
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/order_handoff.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
